title: Invoicify
tagline: Ride on the highway of Interchain transactions with Invoicify
description:
Welcome to Invoicify, a cutting-edge platform that reimagines the world of invoicing and payments. Invoicify is designed to offer a seamless and innovative experience for both users and clients, simplifying the exchange of funds and revolutionizing traditional business transactions.

- Introducing NFT Subscriptions
Invoicify begins by offering users the opportunity to unlock the power of NFT (Non-Fungible Token) subscriptions. These subscriptions are tailored to individual requirements and come in various packages, such as 50 invoices per month, 20 invoices per month, and more. These NFT subscriptions serve as a gateway to our platform's premium services, providing users with access to a specific number of invoices based on their chosen plan. What makes our NFT subscriptions deployed on Scroll Blockchain unique is that they can be transferred, sold, or reacquired by users, adding a layer of flexibility and adaptability to the experience.

- Invoice Creation and Sharing
With an active NFT subscription in hand, users can seamlessly create invoices for their clients. Invoicify provides a user-friendly interface for generating professional and customizable invoices. Users can choose from various templates, add details, and create invoices tailored to their needs. After generating the invoice, users have an innovative and convenient option for sharing it:

*Instant Push Notification*: Invoicify enhances the invoicing experience by offering a unique feature – direct invoice notifications. Clients receive instant notifications of the invoice on their preferred devices. With a single click, clients can access the invoice, check its payment status, pay and engage in real-time communication. This brings opportunity for Push Chat to enhance communication between users and clients.

- Dynamic Discount Coupons
To further enhance the experience, Invoicify introduces dynamic discount coupons as a part of our payment ecosystem. Polygon leads the way in NFT rewards and loyalty, partnering with Starbucks and Flipkart. Now with Invoicfy, we present dynamic NFTs as coupons providing a new usecase of dynamic NFTs as coupons. Clients are greeted with a welcome bonus in the form of a discount coupon NFT. This NFT carries a dynamic value that starts at 10 and decreases with each transaction. This dynamic nature ensures that clients can enjoy savings on their invoices, and the value of the discount coupon evolves with their usage.

The management of discount coupon values is powered by Tableland, which executes SQL queries to update and maintain coupon values as they are used by clients. The changing values of these coupons can also be tracked on popular NFT marketplaces, such as OpenSea.

- Seamless and Secure Interchain Transactions
Invoicify offers a secure and efficient payment gateway through the integration of Hyperlane's warp routes for interchain transactions. Clients can choose to make payments from a variety of blockchain networks. This flexibility ensures that clients have the freedom to use their preferred blockchain for payments.

Once a client chooses a blockchain for payment, Invoicify seamlessly executes the transaction, ensuring quick and reliable settlements. With the ease of Hyperlane's interchain technology, Invoicify takes the hassle out of cross-chain payments, making it a seamless and efficient process.


Invoicify is poised to redefine the landscape of invoicing and payment solutions, combining the power of NFTs, instant notifications, dynamic discount coupons, and interchain transactions into a single, user-friendly platform. Say goodbye to the complexities of traditional invoicing and payment processes and join us in shaping the future of financial transactions.
how_its_made:
Technologies Used:

1. Scroll Blockchain: The backbone of Invoicify's NFT is Scroll Blockchain, ensuring security, transparency, and scalability.
NFT Contracts:
-	https://sepolia.scrollscan.dev/address/0x183c63c231e1e113fd9f00b970f12c4c84e83bd6
-	https://sepolia.scrollscan.dev/address/0xacd96d19B1Cc86262FE83192F16512b63Ed6118B
-	https://sepolia.scrollscan.dev/address/0x44f9Bfd11F1FCFdA0Fa999b02Bf4107a555CfD50
These contracts are deployed on Scroll Sepolia network.

2. Hyperlane: Integrated for efficient interchain transactions. Hyperlane's warp routes enable seamless cross-chain payments, allowing clients to use their preferred blockchain networks for transactions.

3. Polygon: Polygon leads the way in NFT rewards and loyalty, partnering with Starbucks and Flipkart. Now with Invoicfy, we present dynamic NFTs as coupons providing a new usecase of dynamic NFTs as coupons which is deployed on Polygon as well.
NFT Link: https://testnets.opensea.io/assets/mumbai/0x211d9d7b23f36f68fedf616a9d80d4a50d166715/0

4. Tableland: Tableland is used to handle the dynamic values of dynamic discount coupon NFTs. SQL queries are executed to update and maintain coupon values as clients utilize them.
The dynamic NFT Repository can be found here: https://github.com/rk-rishikesh/scratchcard/tree/main

5. Push Protocol: Invoicify leverages push notifications for instant delivery of invoices to clients. This feature simplifies communication and expedites the payment process.
